gen-unbounded-fs-trench-slab: Unbounded stretches out wide, with oversized lowercase and a friendly feel. Below it, Trench Slab keeps capitals barely taller than lowercase, a dignified restraint that tames all that sprawl.
gen-gf-warnes-bitter: Bold ink strokes, stretched wide, tapering off before they touch: that's Warnes. Bitter takes over with very large lowercase eyes and a see-through gap in each s, so paragraphs feel dependable and grounded as they run.
